expected.summary: PROTOTYPE (exploratory, not shipped as of Aug 2026): threshold set by data analysis of production sign-ups — the 11-20 minute overlap band had the worst outcomes (5.84% mistake rate); the mistake multiplier was corrected from 8.5x to 4.3x and the call-off rate is flat at ~12% across bands, so the gate moved from 20 to 10 minutes. Evidence: Bill's corrected analysis, Slack #plus-design-feedback, 2026-08-04.

value.summary: Proposed: an overlap of 1–10 minutes shows a warning; at 11 minutes or more the tutor signs up only by naming the supervisor who asked them to cover. Spring 2026 sign-up data puts the cliff between 10 and 11 minutes: the signed-up-by-mistake rate rises from 1.61% at 6–10 minutes to 5.84% at 11–20, and the share of tutors keeping both overlapping sessions falls from 23% to 5.4%. This replaced an earlier 20-minute line.
